acceptanceCriteria: Findings name the path, the commit and the missing element (marker, listing, run citation).
Merge conflicts confined to configured generated files are not findings.
The split leaves the final tree byte-identical, keeps author, date and message, and prints the old head.
It refuses the unsafe states, and lists only the notes listing and run citation as manual follow-ups.
A mismatch between expected and actual head aborts without changes.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1034 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Changes to shared test infrastructure (helpers, config, fixtures, setup, dependency manifests) affect every test. Policy requires them in separately labelled commits, listed in the ticket notes, with a cited passing affected-run. Authors repeatedly mix them into feature commits, and reviews spend hours reporting it. Current workaround A script checks that the change merges cleanly, that shared-path changes appear only in commits with a marker prefix, that each is listed in a notes section, and that a passing run is cited. A second script rewrites the branch so each mixed commit becomes a shared-only commit followed by the rest, keeping the final tree, authors and later commits, and refuses dirty trees, detached HEAD, merges in range and a live agent session. Proposal `corvint changes check-shared --base REV` with configurable shared-path globs and generated-file exemptions, and ` See beamfall/corvint#1034 for the full text.
title: shared-path change policy: separate labelled commits that cite an affected run, plus mechanical commit splitting (issue #1034)
